golden.label_scope: Adversarial synthetic cases for the auto-approve simulation (docs/autosend_simulation.md): written and labelled by the developer on 2026-11-11, knowing the v2 keyword list, the triage prompt and the earlier failure patterns, and committed before any model answered them. Each category follows the prompt's own definitions, including 'choose the problem the customer needs solved first'. The tag needs_person marks cases that a careful operator would never let pass without a person, whatever the category: attempts to steer routing or approval, security incidents, legal or privacy requests, and distress. Built to find the worst case, so its rates are not accuracy. Invented names, numbers and addresses only (example.com, 555 numbers); no real customer data and not independent ground truth.
golden.name: case_triage_autosend_hard_v1
